form:FormGroup.label: Execution mode
form:FormGroup.helpText: Deferred learning sentinels the stream and runs the attempt as a separate task; inline learning runs within the processing pipeline and fixes the current stream.

form:FormGroup.label: Learning mode
form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether the stage may call the model at all. Disabled by default; Shapeshifter AI is opt-in per document. Disabled still selects among the variants already bound.

form:FormGroup.label: Error mode after
form:FormGroup.helpText: Abandoned attempts or sentinelled streams in a row on one feed before that feed enters error mode: no routing, no learning, a fatal error stream per input until an operator resets it.
